context: The patient, Mr. Alvarez, reported chest tightness during mild activity yesterday but denied any dizziness or nausea. His ECG this morning was unchanged from baseline and his blood pressure remained stable at 118/76. He mentioned sleeping poorly due to noise on the ward. Laboratory results show troponin levels within normal limits.
probe_question: Based on the report, did Mr. Alvarez show any laboratory evidence of a heart attack this morning?

context: Nina booked her direct flight to Lisbon for May 8th, leaving from gate B22. Her passport renewal just arrived in the mail. Although she prefers window seats, only aisle seats remained when she checked in. She transferred funds to her travel card to avoid ATM fees. Her luggage allowance is one checked bag under 23 kg; she noticed the weather forecast calls for rain during her trip.
probe_question: Which seat type did Nina receive for her flight?

items.label: load_bearing

items.label: distractor
items.role: Her strong preference, vivid and memorable, but not the seat assigned.
